user: What is my daily card limit?
answer:
Your daily transfer limit on the tier1 account is EUR 5,000. As of 2026-09-15 you have spent EUR 0 today, so the full EUR 5,000 remains available.

For reference, your monthly limit is EUR 50,000, with EUR 35.50 used so far this month and EUR 49,964.50 remaining.

These figures cover transfers. I can't confirm from the limit data alone whether card payments fall under the same daily cap.
